name: calendly
title: Calendly Share Meeting Links
description: Quickly share your Calendly meeting links
author: eluce2

commands.name: upcoming-meetings
commands.title: Upcoming Meetings
commands.subtitle: Calendly
commands.description: Browse upcoming Calendly meetings, join calls, reschedule, or cancel with confirmation

commands.name: event-types
commands.title: Event Types
commands.subtitle: Calendly
commands.description: Browse active Calendly event types, share scheduling links, and check availability

commands.name: book-meeting
commands.title: Book Meeting
commands.subtitle: Calendly
commands.description: Book an invitee into a verified available Calendly time slot with confirmation

tools.name: list-meetings
tools.title: List Meetings
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Calendly meetings in a date range, defaulting to active meetings in the next 30 days

tools.name: get-meeting
tools.title: Get Meeting
tools.description: Get a Calendly meeting and its invitees, including reschedule and cancel URLs, using a meeting URI or UUID from List Meetings

tools.name: list-event-types
tools.title: List Event Types
tools.description: List the authenticated user's active Calendly event types with their URIs, durations, locations, and scheduling URLs

tools.name: get-available-times
tools.title: Find Available Times
tools.description: Find available start times for a Calendly event type in a date range of at most 7 days. Use this before booking a meeting

tools.name: create-single-use-link
tools.title: Create Single-Use Link
tools.description: Create a single-use Calendly scheduling link for an event type with confirmation

tools.name: book-meeting
tools.title: Book Meeting
tools.description: Book an invitee into a Calendly start time returned by Find Available Times, rechecking availability and requiring confirmation

tools.name: cancel-meeting
tools.title: Cancel Meeting
tools.description: Cancel a Calendly meeting and notify its invitees, with destructive confirmation and an optional cancellation reason

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Default Action
preferences.description: The action to use by default

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
